Business-related undergraduate courses include the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com), Bachelor of Management, and Bachelor of International Business, which typically take 3–4 years to complete. The Bachelor of Entrepreneurship is another option, with the duration varying by university.

Postgraduate business courses include the Master of Business Administration (MBA), Master of Management, and Master of International Business, which generally take 1–2 years to complete. Students can also pursue a Master of Management Studies, depending on the institution, or a Postgraduate Diploma in Business Management, which usually takes 1–2 years
